title: Evidence manifest
description: The record of what was actually read. A citation naming a source absent from this record is a fabrication, so the manifest is the only route by which a document enters the system.

documents.description: One row per document ingested. An EMPTY array is legitimate and means exactly what it says: nothing was read.

items.description: Additional properties are deliberately PERMITTED here, unlike the value-case schema: `vs ingest` also records extraction metadata (character counts, extracted-text filenames, per-document warnings) and rejecting a truthful ingest row for carrying more than the minimum would be the wrong failure. The six required fields are what a citation is checked against.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the FILE BYTES, not the extracted text, so the row keeps identifying the same document even if extraction later improves.

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit offset or Z.
